note: Ball and pin modifications (6 each), the first of the 32. Nine use existing frame-rule pieces; three need new primitives (E18): physics.mod_mass_scale (Lead Core, Lead Weight), physics.gutter_rebound (Bumper Guard) and condition.first_fallen (Spearhead). A modification attaches to one ball card or rack position and its effects join the host's. Nothing here is in content/catalogue.json until E18. E18-C04 landed the eight that use existing rule pieces; Lead Core, Lead Weight, Bumper Guard and Spearhead wait for their primitives (docs/ROADMAP.md).

item.name: Lead Core
item.downside: Less hook: a curved line bends 15% less, and it cannot core a Hammer Ball.

design.trigger: The cored ball's mass is ×1.2 for every roll (multiplied with the ball's own profile) and its hook response ×0.85, so it carries through pins on a straighter line.
design.pool: Shop modification slot; initial pool from Division 1. Attaches to one ball card (one modification per ball).
design.presentation_needs: A badge on the host card and a small overlay on the host in play; the host's own silhouette and marking stay readable. A heavier roll sound and a dense core mark; the aim preview shows the reduced hook.

item.name: Bumper Guard
item.downside: A rescued roll costs 2 Mult (never below 1), and it does nothing for a roll that stays on the lane.

design.trigger: The first time in a frame a roll thrown with this ball reaches a gutter, it rebounds once off a bumper toward the pins instead of being voided. Pins it then knocks down count; that roll gives −2 Mult, never taking Mult below 1.
design.pool: Shop modification slot; initial pool from Division 2. Attaches to one ball card (one modification per ball).
design.presentation_needs: A badge on the host card and a small overlay on the host in play; the host's own silhouette and marking stay readable. A visible bumper rail appears only for the rebound; the −2 Mult is named in the explanation.

item.name: Lead Weight
item.downside: Harder to knock down, so it stands more often; cannot weight an Anchor pin.

design.trigger: The weighted pin's mass is ×1.3, so it is harder to topple and carries further when it does fall; +15 Value when it is knocked down.
design.pool: Shop modification slot; initial pool from Division 1. Attaches to one rack position (one modification per pin).
design.presentation_needs: A badge on the host card and a small overlay on the host in play; the host's own silhouette and marking stay readable. A heavier impact sound for the weighted pin.

item.name: Spearhead
item.downside: Only the pin the ball meets first pays, which on most racks means the head pin.

design.trigger: +30 Value if the tipped pin is the first pin knocked down in the frame (the lowest knockdown sequence of roll 1, the mirror of Crown Pin's last-fallen test); otherwise nothing.
design.pool: Shop modification slot; initial pool from Division 2. Attaches to one rack position (one modification per pin).
design.presentation_needs: A badge on the host card and a small overlay on the host in play; the host's own silhouette and marking stay readable. During resolution, shows whether it fell first (the +30) or not (a clear 0).

design.trigger: +2 Mult for each roll thrown with the chalked ball in a frame that ends as a spare (both rolls count when both use it). A strike or an open frame gets nothing.
design.pool: Shop modification slot; initial pool from Division 1. Attaches to one ball card (one modification per ball).
design.presentation_needs: A badge on the host card and a small overlay on the host in play; the host's own silhouette and marking stay readable. A chalk-dust puff on release in a spare frame.

design.trigger: +4 Mult for each roll thrown with the waxed ball in a frame where any roll curved (committed spin past the curve threshold). A frame of straight rolls gets nothing.
design.pool: Unlocked by the True Curve objective; then the modification slot from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A badge on the host card and a small overlay on the host in play; the host's own silhouette and marking stay readable. A wax sheen on the ball's curve trail, readable without colour.

design.trigger: Pays $2 after the bank when a roll thrown with this ball is a strike, credited with the frame income. A spare or an open frame pays nothing; a retrigger never pays twice.
design.pool: Shop modification slot; initial pool from Division 1. Attaches to one ball card (one modification per ball).
design.presentation_needs: A badge on the host card and a small overlay on the host in play; the host's own silhouette and marking stay readable. A coin-slot mark; the payout uses the shared coin feedback after the bank.

design.trigger: Retriggers the scoring effects of the first pin the charged ball knocks down directly that roll, once, in that pin's rack slot: Echo Ball's rule on any other ball.
design.pool: Unlocked by the first House League title; then the modification slot from Division 2.
design.presentation_needs: A badge on the host card and a small overlay on the host in play; the host's own silhouette and marking stay readable. Concentric pulses like Echo's, but as a ring on the host ball so the two never read alike.

design.trigger: +1 Mult when the capped pin is knocked down; a retrigger of that pin repeats it. It adds no Value and the pin keeps all of its own effects.
design.pool: Shop modification slot; initial pool from Division 1. Attaches to one rack position (one modification per pin).
design.presentation_needs: A badge on the host card and a small overlay on the host in play; the host's own silhouette and marking stay readable.

design.trigger: Pays $1 after the bank when the gilded pin falls, credited with the frame income. A retrigger never pays twice; a standing gilded pin pays nothing.
design.pool: Shop modification slot; initial pool from Division 1. Attaches to one rack position (one modification per pin).
design.presentation_needs: A badge on the host card and a small overlay on the host in play; the host's own silhouette and marking stay readable. Gold leaf over the base material, not a recolour of Gold Pin.

design.trigger: While the lit pin is still standing when the frame ends, +1 Mult for each pin left standing (itself included). A strike or a spare knocks it down and pays nothing.
design.pool: Shop modification slot; initial pool from Division 1. Attaches to one rack position (one modification per pin).
design.presentation_needs: A badge on the host card and a small overlay on the host in play; the host's own silhouette and marking stay readable. A small flame that stays lit while the pin stands; it counts the standing pins in the rack diagram.

design.trigger: When the keystone pin falls, +4 Value for each pin knocked down this frame, itself included (a strike gives +40). If it stands, nothing.
design.pool: Unlocked by the Mixed Rack objective; then the modification slot from Division 2.
design.presentation_needs: A badge on the host card and a small overlay on the host in play; the host's own silhouette and marking stay readable. A carved keystone mark; the count reads as pins down in the rack diagram.
